# rename

Muster-owned session title override, inline rename in the mainhead and tiles.

- Spec: `docs/features/rename/spec.md`
- Contract: `docs/features/rename/contract.md`

## Files

```
go: internal/server/sessions*.go
go: internal/server/title_test.go
go: internal/session/title_test.go
web: web/src/features/rename.ts
web: web/src/render/rename.ts
web: web/src/sessions/rename*.ts
e2e: web/e2e/rename.spec.ts
```

## Protocol

- `sessions.title` — `PUT /api/sessions/{id}/title`

## Decisions

- `kb:adr/rename-muster-owned-title-override-wins` — A post-launch rename is a Muster-owned nullable title override that wins over the status-line name; the wire title is the display title. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: rename, tiles, focus) → `docs/adr/rename-muster-owned-title-override-wins.md`
- `kb:adr/views-active-segment-click-commits-rename` — Clicking the already-pressed view segment commits an open rename instead of cancelling it and sends no prefs request; switching views still cancels. (accepted, 2026-09-03; features: views, rename) → `docs/adr/views-active-segment-click-commits-rename.md`

## Facts

- `kb:fact/name-flag-reaches-title` — claude --name X yields SessionStart.session_title == X and status-line session_name == X; the title survives --resume. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.267..2.1.267; features: launch, rename) → `docs/facts/name-flag-reaches-title.md`
- `kb:fact/status-session-name-source` — Status-line session_name carries --name when given, otherwise a title Claude Code auto-generates; it is absent until one exists. (active, 2026-09-11; verified 2.1.233..2.1.267; features: rename, usage) → `docs/facts/status-session-name-source.md`

## Retired, rejected and superseded

- `kb:adr/rename-title-from-status-line-session-name` — A session's displayed title is read from the status line's session_name, which reflects --name, /rename and the auto-generated title alike. (superseded, 2026-08-16; features: rename, usage) → `docs/adr/rename-title-from-status-line-session-name.md`
